title: Checkin

project_ids.description: Limit the choice to these projects. By default the server considers every project you are active in.

assignment_id.description: The assignment the rig is working on, if any.

unsubmitted_captures.description:
Everything this rig has captured but not yet submitted, as totals per panel. Each
report replaces the rig's last one; send `[]` once all is submitted, or omit the
field to leave the last report as it is. For a masters project, this is how the
server learns of subs waiting to be stacked.

description: Ask what this rig should image.
